commitResults.messageTitle: Change Duke to Mouse
Create Greeting
Level1. Echo complete. Create command/input loop
Add List command functions. Lvl 2
Level 3 step 1: mark tasks as done without a Task class.
commitResults.messageBody: Keep a parallel isDone list so mark N can update status and list can show [X] or [ ].

commitResults.messageTitle: Level 3 step 2: unmark tasks without a Task class.
commitResults.messageBody: Reuse the parallel isDone list so unmark N can clear a task's done status.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level 3 step 3: introduce a Task class.
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the parallel description and isDone lists with Task objects so status and text stay together.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add present-changes-visually skill for Cursor.
commitResults.messageBody: Port the se-edu HTML split-view diff skill so changes can be reviewed without Codex.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ToDo, Event, Deadline Classes
Create new classes: Parser, TaskList, UI
Add edge cases to ui-test-plan.md and handle out-of-bounds marking.
commitResults.messageBody: The tests ensure that bad inputs (missing /by delimiters, out-of-bounds mark indexes, unknown commands) throw a MouseException (which the Ui class prints cleanly) without crashing the program or corrupting the task list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level 5: Handle errors and edge cases using exceptions.
commitResults.messageBody: MouseException is now thrown by the Parser on bad input, and caught by Mouse to print a friendly error message via Ui.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level 6: Delete tasks using ArrayList.
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the fixed-size Task array with an ArrayList to support dynamic sizing and task removal. The 'delete N' command uses Parser.parseIndex and removes the item, returning the removed Task so Ui can print it.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a UI test that adds a todo, deadline, and event.
commitResults.messageBody: The existing plan never checked a successful mixed-type add and list, so broken /by or /from parsing could still pass.

commitResults.messageTitle: Assert specific error messages in UI tests.
commitResults.messageBody: Ui.showError now prints the actual exception text, so invalid-input cases can fail if the wrong error is shown.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a UI test that delete keeps remaining done status.
commitResults.messageBody: Without this, a delete that dropped isDone on later tasks would still pass the existing list check.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a UI test for mark after delete reindexing.
commitResults.messageBody: This catches a delete that leaves holes or fails to shift later tasks into the vacated index.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a UI test for listing an empty task list.
commitResults.messageBody: Startup list and list-after-deleting-the-last-task would otherwise go untested.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add UI tests for malformed delete, deadline, and event input.
commitResults.messageBody: These cases cover empty /by and /to values, reversed event times, and junk after a task number.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update UI test plan source file list.
commitResults.messageBody: The plan still listed only Mouse and Task, which hid the classes the runner actually compiles.

commitResults.messageTitle: Print Java stderr when a UI test case fails.
commitResults.messageBody: Stdout alone hid stack traces when Mouse crashed, which made crash-vs-mismatch failures hard to diagnose.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use CommandType and TaskType enums for commands and task letters.
commitResults.messageBody: Replace string prefix checks and hardcoded [T]/[D]/[E] symbols with enums so invalid command words cannot be confused with magic strings.
